title: An Antarctic Ice Shelf Bigger Than Rhode Island Vanished in 35 Days

scenes.text: An Antarctic ice shelf vanished in just 35 days.
It was Larsen B, about 220 metres thick, floating off the Antarctic Peninsula.
In early 2002 it began to shatter. In 35 days, about 3,250 square kilometres broke apart. That's bigger than Rhode Island.
About 720 billion tons of ice, gone.
NASA says warm summers made meltwater ponds that wedged the cracks open until the shelf splintered.
Thirty-five days. That's all it took.

description:
In early 2002 the Larsen B ice shelf in Antarctica disintegrated: about 3,250 square kilometres of ice, roughly 220 metres thick, broke apart in 35 days.
NASA estimates it released around 720 billion tons of ice, and the lost area was larger than Rhode Island.
What do you think we should learn from it?
